case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You pointed to labour and material costs behind your price, and you want a partnership that lasts. Our options answer both: each one runs for a longer contract term, which gives your team a steady base for planning, and Option A is the one we can approve.

On quality:
Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

That is why Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a longer commitment from a customer you already know, at a price that reflects the quality we receive.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As you are not the one who decides on your side, please take Option A to the person who does. We would like a fair solution for both family companies, and this is a clear step towards it.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. While company policy prevents us from sharing a detailed cost breakdown, we appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract and 45-day payment terms. We can accommodate these terms with a revised unit price of €4.90. 

I am fully authorized to negotiate and conclude this agreement on behalf of Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Our Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €4.90 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You told us that material is the weight behind your price and that you cannot open your cost breakdown further. We respect that.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As you handle this on your side, please take Option A to whoever signs off on volume agreements at Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd, so that we can settle it as a fair solution for both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your revised offer and the slight increase in your proposed prices.

Please be assured that I am fully authorized to negotiate and conclude this agreement on behalf of Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. To maintain our great partnership, our main offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

In response to your movement, we can offer a minor adjustment to €4.89 for the 45-day payment term and 24-month contract. Specifically, this alternative package includes a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You wrote that you want to keep our great partnership, and we want the same for our two family companies. We have taken your movement seriously and have adjusted our options once more, as a serious effort to close.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As you have told us you are fully authorized, we hope you can do this directly. If a colleague must agree first, please take Option A to the person who decides.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your continued effort to reach an agreement and value our relationship. We are always eager to support your operations with our extensive inventory and dedicated service. 

However, we cannot accommodate any further price reductions for the 45-day payment term and 24-month contract. Therefore, we must present €4.89 as our final offer for this package. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We also offer the following alternative package: a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €4.89 per unit.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

decision.intent: appreciative: we accept your alternative proposal as offered

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You called your alternative package your final offer, and we take that as it is meant. We accept it as you offered it, so that both family companies have a clear and reliable basis for the coming contract term.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 4.89; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

This is your own alternative package, unchanged. Please confirm it to us in writing, and we will confirm the order straight away.

We are glad to settle this with you directly and look forward to a steady cooperation on the 6306.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
